row: Injured in a car accident? Suffering from a sports injury? Do you have back pain, neck pain, or headaches? Owsley Chiropractic is located in Bowling Green, KY just off Scottsville Road. At Owsley Chiropractic we offer: Same Day Appointments, Walk In Appointments, Emergency Care without Waiting, Physical Therapy Treatment, we have a full time Licensed Massage Therapist, and offer a Functional Movement Rehabilitation program. Life has a way of throwing pain at us- accidents, sports injuries or everyday cubicle wear and tear. In the push and pull of todays crowded atmosphere, we often carry the world on our shoulders. Your body doesn't always tell you what it needs in a language you can understand; aches and pains can sometimes be indicative of larger issues. Or it could be that your body simply wants some much-needed stress relief. Dr. Owsley will work with you to target the root of your pain and get you back to your best. You'll feel the difference throughout your body and your day.
